articles.text: GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Dàtīnglide zhuōzi dōu bǎihǎo le meiyou?
FIRST EMPLOYEE: Have all the tables in the large hall been set?
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Bǎihǎo le. Jīntian yòu shi huānsòng shéi ya?
SECOND EMPLOYEE: Yes. Who is it that is being given a send-off today?
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Huānsòng yíge Xiānggǎng láide lǜshī dàibiǎotuán.
FIRST EMPLOYEE: A delegation of lawyers from Hong Kong.
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Lǜshī? Fǎlǜ gōngzuòzhě gēn Guǎngjiāohuì yǒu shénme guānxi?
SECOND EMPLOYEE: Lawyers? What connection do legal workers have with the Guǎngzhōu Trade Fair?
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Xiànzài Zhōngguó hé wàishāngde hézuò yuè lái yuè duō le.
FIRST EMPLOYEE: China is cooperating more and more with foreign merchants.
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Zhōngguó yào jìnkǒu shèbèi, yào gǎo jiāgōng gōngyè, huòshi yào gǎo biéde jīngjì hézuò, dōu xūyào lǜshī a!
FIRST EMPLOYEE: If China wants to import equipment, to do processing or finishing of products, or have any other economic cooperation, they need lawyers!
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Wǒ háishi juéde yǒu yìdiǎnr qíguài, bù zěnme qīngchu, wǒ cónglái méi xiǎngdào fǎlǜ hé jīngjì hái yǒu guānxi.
SECOND EMPLOYEE: I still think that's kind of strange. I don't really understand. I never thought that law had anything to do with economics.

GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Wàiguó shāngren ma, jiàqian na, zīběn na, shénmede, dōu yào yòng fǎlǜ xiěqīngchude, yàoburán, tāmen zěnme zhīdao bǎozhèng kěyi zhuàn qián ne? Bù kěyi zhuàn qián, tāmen wèishénme yào hé wǒmen zuò mǎimai ne?

FIRST EMPLOYEE: Foreign merchants, you know. They have to write out clearly their prices and capital in legal terms, otherwise how can they know for sure that they are guaranteed to make money? And if they can't make any money, why would they want to do business with us?
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Ō! Nǐ zhèi yí shuō wǒ jiù qīngchu le. Yǒule fǎlǜ bǎozhèng, wàishāng cái kěn zuò mǎimai.
SECOND EMPLOYEE: Oh! When you put it that way, I understand. Foreign merchants are only willing to do business if they have legal guarantees.
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Hǎo le, zài qù kànkan, wǎnhuìshang xūyàode dōngxi dōu yào jízhōng fànghǎode.
FIRST EMPLOYEE: Okay, go back and take a look. The things we'll need during the banquet should all be put together in one place.
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Hǎo, jìde le.
SECOND EMPLOYEE: All right, I won't forget.
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Hái yǒu, nǐ tīngdào xiāoxi le meiyou?
FIRST EMPLOYEE: And another thing: Have you heard the news?
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Méiyou a, shénme xiāoxi?
SECOND EMPLOYEE: No, what news?
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Jīntian wǎnshangde huānsònghuì bú tài píngcháng.
FIRST EMPLOYEE: Tonight's farewell meeting isn't going to be an ordinary one.
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Zěnme bù píngcháng ne?
SECOND EMPLOYEE: How's that?

GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Guǎngdōng shěng, Guǎngzhōu shì gèjí rénmín zhèngfǔ dōu yào pài hěn zhòngyàode rén lái. Yǒu hěn duō hěn zhòngyàode shì yào zài zhèr tán, wǒmen děi bǎ shénme dōu zhǔnbèihǎo, ràng lǐngdǎo fàng xīn.

FIRST EMPLOYEE: All levels of the people's government of Guǎngdōng province and the city of Guǎngzhōu are sending very important people. They'll be talking about a lot of important things here. We should prepare everything well and put the leadership at ease.
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN YǏ: Méi wèntí, wǒ zài qù jiǎnchá yícì. Nín dāi huǐr kě děi zài lái kàn yíxiàr a!
SECOND EMPLOYEE: That won't be any problem. I'll go back and check once more. But later you have to go look things over once yourself!
GŌNGZUÒ RÉNYUÁN JIǍ: Hǎo, dāi huǐr wǒ jiù lái.
FIRST EMPLOYEE: Okay, I'll be right there.
